recap.text: Two crawlers buy security from the Sledge and Bomo at a bar. Princess Donut drinks a dirty Shirley in a bowl and dances on the Sledge's shoulders while he does the robot. After the Sledge misses an attack on the Princess, Carl makes the Sledge and Bomo permanent security for the Royal Court. The Sledge spends his own money on a blue protection spell and enters the Dodge room with the Princess.

Carl's lawyer trades the Gate of the Feral Gods for four mercenaries, including The Sledge, who receives the spell Zerzura. The Sledge uses copies of himself to trigger a trap and deliver a fake cat to Lucia before wheeling a bomb to a door. He plays Grand Theft Auto with Bomo and a changeling kid. After fighting mantises, he enters a castle through a turret. He casts Zerzura, which removes the castle and every NPC inside.

The Princess tells The Sledge he was the best bodyguard she ever had and headbutts him before returning to Carl. The Sledge casts Zerzura, and Rosetta says Shanty Town is in the glow. Carl tells The Sledge he made a difference.

beats.headline: Bought at the bar
beats.text: Two crawlers come up to the counter and buy security. Me and Bomo, sold as the pair. That is the arrangement in this place. You pay, and we stand between you and whatever comes through the door. The cat is not what I expect. She orders a dirty Shirley in a bowl with extra cherries, drinks the whole thing, and then she wants dancing, so I do my version of the robot while she bops and twirls on my shoulders. Princess Donut. I let her.
beats.gist: Two crawlers buy security at the bar; The Sledge and Bomo are sold as a pair.

beats.headline: A miss on his own shift
beats.text: A crawler goes for the Princess on my floor, on my shift, and I do not get there in time. Elle puts the second one down. Astrid comes to apologise in person, and I stand where I am and wait to hear what a miss like that costs a body like me. Carl does not ask for blood. He asks for me and Bomo, permanent and complimentary, the Royal Court's own security every time they walk in. So now I have a court.
beats.gist: The Sledge fails to stop a crawler from reaching the Princess, so Carl hires him.

beats.headline: A spell bought with my own money
beats.text: The Princess rides on my shoulder through the club now. As we cross the dance floor I cast a protection spell on the party, and everyone glows blue. I bought it with my own money. Bomo tells Carl so, which is the longest sentence anyone has heard from Bomo. The Princess says thank you, Sledgie, and pats my head. The Dodge room will not let Carl in. It lets me in with her. Carl waits at the bar.
beats.gist: The Sledge casts a blue protection spell on the party using his own money.

beats.headline: Part of the price of the Gate
beats.text: Carl's lawyer trades the Gate of the Feral Gods back, and I am part of what he gets for it. Four of us, free of charge: me, Bomo, Clay-ton, Very Sullen. Two spells on top, one for Bomo and one for me, copies of what the artifact could do. Bomo gets the jump to the stairwell. I get Zerzura. Nobody explains Zerzura to me. Nobody has to.
beats.gist: Carl's lawyer trades the Gate of the Feral Gods and gives Sledge, Bomo, Clay-ton, and Very Sullen.

beats.headline: Two copies and a bomb
beats.text: The Princess casts on me and there are three of us. The two copies go into the saferoom, one after the other. The first hits the trap and lands outside among the hunters, and it explodes there. The second carries the fake cat to Lucia. I wheel the bomb to the door, like Carl said, and stand there. Two mantises run at us. Carl kicks the bomb out and slams the door.
beats.gist: The Princess casts copies of The Sledge, who wheels a bomb to a door.

beats.headline: Grand Theft Auto
beats.text: Carl rigged up a television. Grand Theft Auto. Bomo and me play it all the time. A changeling kid sits on my lap. I show him how to steal a car. Carl tells Mordecai we are why the kids stay in the room.
beats.gist: Carl rigs a television for Grand Theft Auto, which he and Bomo play with a changeling kid.

beats.headline: Mantises at the tunnel
beats.text: Mantises. Lots of mantises. Everywhere. They keep coming, flying in. We have to fight them. Carl says get in the tunnels, try not to fight, get the changelings through that door. Too many. We get picked up by airship. We go in from above instead. Carl says be careful of the sentinel towers, use the bombs on them if I have to, and drop none on the main castle. Louis says tell Skarn to moor the ship to the tower.
beats.gist: Carl tells The Sledge to move changelings through a door while fighting flying mantises.

beats.headline: Surviving is winning
beats.text: Louis is worried about how it is going. Whether the plan holds, how it looks, who comes out on top of it. Surviving is winning, Louis. Everything else is bullshit. Then the changelings and me go into that castle, through a turret and the elf inside it, which is the thing everyone outside said could not be done.
beats.gist: The Sledge tells Louis surviving is winning and enters a castle through a turret and an elf.

beats.headline: No let Bomo beat my Frogger score
beats.text: Carl says do it. Casting now. One minute to chant, five minutes to cast. He says I am inside the castle, so I go to the ninth floor with everyone else, the cat too, and to watch him. I will feel sick for a full day. He thanks me for doing this and for taking care of the Princess. No let Bomo beat my Frogger score. He says he will unplug the machine the moment they get back. Good.
beats.gist: Carl tells The Sledge to cast. The Sledge goes to the ninth floor to watch.

beats.headline: He finishes casting Zerzura
beats.text: The battle is everywhere and my job is to stand still and finish the words. So I stand still and finish the words. The castle goes. The whole building and every NPC breathing inside it, taken out from under the people who thought they owned them. That is what the spell was for. I said I did not need it explained.
beats.gist: The Sledge stands still and finishes casting Zerzura, removing the castle and every NPC inside it.

beats.headline: I made a difference?
beats.text: The Princess says goodbye. Best bodyguard anyone ever had. Maybe I see her again. Maybe I see Bomo. She no need bodyguard anymore. She says she will always need me. She headbutts me, and goes back to Carl. I start to cast. Zerzura. Five minutes. Rosetta says Shanty Town is in the glow. Twenty seconds, I say. I look at Carl. I made a difference? He says I did.
beats.gist: The Princess headbutts The Sledge and returns to Carl.
